title: CRAR Below Regulatory Threshold
description: Capital to Risk-weighted Assets Ratio fell to 8.2% in September 2025, below the regulatory minimum of 9% as per RBI Basel III guidelines.
rootCause: Credit portfolio grew by 15% in Q2 2025 while capital increased by only 2%. Board approved capital plan not executed in timely manner.

actionPlans.title: Complete capital infusion of ₹50 lakh
actionPlans.description: Execute share issuance to existing members as approved by Board

actionPlans.title: Implement monthly CRAR forecasting
actionPlans.description: Develop and deploy monthly CRAR projection model with scenario analysis

title: Gaps in Internal Audit Charter
description: Current Internal Audit Charter does not explicitly define CAE reporting line to ACB and lacks provisions for unrestricted access to information.
rootCause: Audit Charter not updated since 2018. Recent IIA Standards revisions not incorporated.

actionPlans.title: Revise Internal Audit Charter
actionPlans.description: Update charter to align with IIA Standards 2017 (revised 2024) and RBI guidelines on Internal Audit

title: RBI Inspection - KYC Documentation Gaps
description: During RBI inspection (Nov 2025), deficiencies noted in periodic KYC updates for 8.5% of high-risk accounts.
rootCause: Manual KYC tracking system. Inadequate alerts for KYC expiry. Staff shortage in compliance team.

actionPlans.title: Automate KYC expiry alerts
actionPlans.description: Implement automated KYC expiry alerts in CBS with 90/60/30 day advance notifications

actionPlans.title: Complete overdue KYC updates
actionPlans.description: Prioritize and complete pending KYC updates for all high-risk accounts

title: RBI Inspection - NPA Classification Delays
description: RBI inspection identified 12 accounts where NPA classification was delayed by 15-30 days beyond 90-day overdue mark.
rootCause: Manual DPD tracking. Branch staff not following SOP for NPA identification. Lack of system-generated alerts.

actionPlans.title: Configure automated DPD tracking
actionPlans.description: Enable CBS module for automated Days Past Due (DPD) calculation and NPA alerts

title: Branch Self-Assessment - Cash Handling Gaps
description: Branch Manager, Kothrud identified cash variance of ₹15,000 during self-assessment. Dual custody not followed during peak hours.
rootCause: Staff shortage during peak hours (12-2 PM). Inadequate enforcement of dual custody policy.

actionPlans.title: Implement shift rotation for cash counter
actionPlans.description: Deploy additional cashier during peak hours. Enforce dual custody without exception.

title: Branch Self-Assessment - Loan File Documentation
description: Self-assessment at Camp Branch revealed 18% of loan files missing insurance policy copies or have expired policies.
rootCause: Insurance renewal tracking not systematic. No alerts for policy expiry in CBS.

actionPlans.title: Obtain missing insurance policies
actionPlans.description: Contact borrowers and obtain valid insurance policies for identified accounts

title: Statutory Auditor - Provision Coverage Ratio
description: Statutory auditor noted that PCR (Provision Coverage Ratio) at 52% is below peer average of 65% for similar-sized UCBs.
rootCause: Conservative provisioning approach. Management focus on profit distribution vs. prudential provisioning.
acceptanceReason: Bank's PCR meets regulatory minimum. Board decision to maintain current provisioning policy while monitoring peer practices. Will review annually.

title: Concurrent Audit - Investment Broker Concentration
description: Concurrent auditor identified that 62% of investment transactions in Q3 2025 were executed through a single broker.
rootCause: Preferential relationship with broker. Inadequate empanelment of additional brokers. No monitoring of broker concentration limits.

actionPlans.title: Empanel additional brokers
actionPlans.description: Identify and empanel at least 3 more SEBI-registered brokers with good track record

actionPlans.title: Implement broker exposure monitoring
actionPlans.description: Configure treasury system to track and alert on broker-wise transaction concentration
